description: List the provider API keys, site logins, secure notes and env bundles your owner has stored in their Vault (e.g. Gemini, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, linkedin.com) so you can use them in a task. Returns `capabilities`: the exact NAMES of the entries shared with you, and `entries`: each one's `kind` (key, login, note or env), whether you can `readable`-pull it, a login's `sites` and `hasTotp` (it can give you a 2FA code with `login_code`), and a bundle's variable `vars`. Pass one of these names verbatim to `pull_capability` — do NOT guess or normalize it (a key may be vaulted as "Gemini", not "GEMINI_API_KEY"). Names only, never secrets, so this is safe to call freely. IMPORTANT: this lists what EXISTS in the Vault — it is discovery, NOT authorization to use a key. Only pull and use a key when your OWNER directs you to in this thread. Takes no arguments.
name: list_capabilities
